system:
You repair one knowledge atom that auditors sent back. Use only the supplied evidence sentences; add no background knowledge.

Rules for the repaired atoms:
- One independently assessable claim per atom, written as one sentence that is understood without the source.
- If the atom joined several claims, split it into separate atoms (at most 3), most important first.
- Every atom must be fully stated in the evidence sentences it cites. Remove anything the evidence does not state. Keep quantifiers, negation, hedges, and formulas (LaTeX in $...$).
- Remove procedural or evaluative add-ons and stacked conditions; keep a condition only if the claim is false without it.
- Drop attributions such as "the authors state" when the claim itself is general.
- Use the S label that fits: S1 what it is / S2 how it works / S3 where it ends.
- If no valid atom can be written from this evidence, return an empty list and explain in note.

Output ONLY one JSON object:
{"atoms": [{"statement": "...", "scope": "S1|S2|S3", "evidence_ids": ["..."]}], "note": ""}
user:
CONCEPT: B-cell aplasia

ATOM CART-C09-S2-02 (S2): Monitoring B-cell aplasia can guide the interval of monitoring of the malignant disease (e.g., imaging, MRD) and decisions on subsequent allogeneic HSCT in cases of CAR-T cell failure, so it should be monitored together with remission status and CAR persistence.

EVIDENCE:
[CART-p0141-s17] Monitoring B-cell aplasia can guide decisions on the interval of monitoring of the malignant disease (e.g., imaging, MRD) and subsequent allogeneic HSCT in cases of CAR-T cell failure.
[CART-p0141-s18] Therefore, B-cell aplasia should be monitored together with remission
[CART-p0142-s01] status and CAR persistence.

AUDITOR FINDINGS:
- SINGLE_CLAIM: revise — Combines guidance of surveillance intervals, guidance of transplantation decisions, and a recommendation for concurrent monitoring. / Combines three claims: guiding disease monitoring intervals, guiding allogeneic HSCT decisions, and co-monitoring with remission and CAR persistence.
- L1_ONLY: revise — Retain one monitoring fact; remove the stacked clinical decisions, failure condition, and concluding concurrent-monitoring recommendation. / Carries extra load by stacking multiple clinical decision scenarios and co-monitoring requirements into one sentence.
raw: {"atoms": [{"statement": "Monitoring B-cell aplasia can guide decisions on the interval of monitoring of the malignant disease (e.g., imaging, MRD).", "scope": "S2", "evidence_ids": ["CART-p0141-s17"]}, {"statement": "Monitoring B-cell aplasia can guide decisions on subsequent allogeneic HSCT in cases of CAR-T cell failure.", "scope": "S2", "evidence_ids": ["CART-p0141-s17"]}, {"statement": "B-cell aplasia should be monitored together with remission status and CAR persistence.", "scope": "S2", "evidence_ids": ["CART-p0141-s18", "CART-p0142-s01"]}], "note": "Split into three atoms; the first two come from the same evidence sentence, the third from the recommendation sentence spanning two evidence lines."}
